title: Decoding by kind
hints: Decode in two steps. First decode each element into a struct with Kind string and Spec json.RawMessage. RawMessage keeps the spec's raw bytes for later.
Then switch on Kind: unmarshal Spec into a Circle or a Rect, and append it to the result as a Shape.
The default case should return an error that names the unknown kind, e.g. fmt.Errorf("unknown shape kind %q", k). Return errors from the inner Unmarshal too.
